Title: 2025-12-04 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: === Battlegrounds: Blackheart's Bay ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Blackheart's Bay ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Bombardment
    • [Undocumented] Now prioritize the top lane, the bottom lane, and then the middle lane.
      • [Undocumented] Fort-level Structures are still targeted before Keep-level Structures.

=== Battlegrounds: Cursed Hollow ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Fallback Towers on Cursed Hollow to not be disabled during the Raven Lord's Curse.

=== Battlegrounds: Volskaya Foundry ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing some ground elements to not display correctly.

=== Heroes: Kael'thas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue allowing Kael'thas to target with Living Bomb enemies that have already been targeted with Living Bomb.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the Quest progress for Kael'thas's Convection to not be tracked correctly.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Kerrigan's Ravage to not display correctly.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Ravaging Ferocity to still use the Talent ID for Sharpened Blades.

=== Heroes: Lúcio ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing AI to activate Lúcio's Summer Anthem without the Talent being taken.

=== Heroes: Stukov ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the range bonus from Stukov's It Hungers to display incorrectly when targeting Lurking Arm.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the remaining duration of Sylvanas's Haunting Arrows to not display correctly.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Sylvanas's Possession to require 4 charges when targeting Catapults or Reavers.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Unrelenting Torment to still use the Talent ID for Unfurling Shadows.

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Tychus's Overkill to apply the Slow from Spray 'n' Pray without the Talent being taken.

=== Heroes: Valla ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the status tooltip for Valla's Hatred to not display correctly.

=== Heroes: Zul'jin ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Zul'jin's You Want Axe to not remove gained bonuses properly upon dying.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Zul'jin's You Want Axe to not increase correctly after hitting more than 1000 Basic Attacks.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the second rotation of Zul'jin's Twin Cleave to display incorrectly.
